items.stem: A control ensures that data has not been altered in transit. Which element of the CIA triad does it support?

options.rationale: Correct: integrity is about data being accurate and unaltered.
Confidentiality concerns who can read data, not whether it was altered.
Availability concerns access and uptime, not alteration.
Accounting tracks actions; it is not part of the CIA triad.

items.stem: What does an intrusion detection system (IDS) do when it sees a suspicious packet?

options.rationale: Correct: an IDS detects and alerts; it does not block by itself (an IPS blocks).
Blocking is the role of an IPS, not a passive IDS.
An IDS does not perform network encryption.
That is not a function of an IDS.

items.stem: Which TWO actions should be taken FIRST when handling a potentially compromised host? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Preserve volatile evidence before powering down
options.rationale: Correct: volatile data is lost on shutdown, so preserve it first.

options.text: Follow the organisation's incident response plan
options.rationale: Correct: acting within the IR plan keeps the response controlled and lawful.

options.text: Post the incident publicly on social media
options.rationale: That is inappropriate disclosure and harms the response.

options.text: Ignore it until the next maintenance window
options.rationale: Delay lets the compromise spread and evidence decay.

items.explanation: Correct: volatile data is lost on shutdown, so preserve it first.
